proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic toggled light-emission mechanic with a fixed radius, but the surface has no effect atom for granting bright/dim light.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has an alter_item_kind effect, but no attachment variant that lets an activation target the held item whose form changes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff

proposed_widenings.name: item_form_gated_passive_or_activation
proposed_widenings.justification: Several properties only apply in some forms, so the surface needs a way to gate passive grants and reactive activations on the current form of the same item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties

proposed_widenings.name: return_to_hand_after_thrown_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants a thrown attack profile plus an automatic return rider after the ranged attack resolves; no current effect atom models that return behavior.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand

notes: Top-level fit is existing magic_item + composite mechanics, not a new family. The cleanly encodable subset (+2 attack and damage with this weapon, reaction +5 AC once per short or long rest) is still blocked by missing form-scoped gating, so no honest content file was authored.
